mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity ( created_at, activity_name, activity_description, uid, username, permission, activity_category, activity_status, activity_location, activity_time_early, activity_time_end, activity_picture_id, activity_cover_image, activity_like_number, activity_comment_number, activity_review_status ) VALUES ( NOW(), #{activityName}, #{activityDescription}, #{uid}, #{username}, #{permission}, #{activityCategory}, #{activityStatus}, #{activityLocation}, #{activityTimeEarly}, #{activityTimeEnd}, #{activityPictureId}, #{activityCoverImage}, #{activityLikeNumber}, #{activityCommentNumber}, #{activityReviewStatus} )
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET activity_name = #{activityName}, activity_description = #{activityDescription}, activity_cover_image = #{activityCoverImage}, activity_location = #{activityLocation}, activity_time_early = #{activityTimeEarly}, activity_time_end = #{activityTimeEnd}, activity_category = #{activityCategory}, activity_status = #{activityStatus}, activity_review_status = #{activityReviewStatus} WHERE activity_id = #{activityId}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM activity WHERE activity_review_status = 1 ORDER BY activity_id ASC
